description_en: Creates a build instance based on the current configuration of a specified task, and freezes the input and runtime configurations for this execution
description_zh: 按指定任务的当前配置创建一次构建实例，并固定本次输入和运行配置
name: CreateKnowledgeBaseBuildTaskInstance

parameters.help_en: The idempotency key for this creation request. We recommend providing it for automatic retries. Reuse the same value when retrying the same operation
parameters.help_zh: 本次创建幂等键；自动重试建议传入，相同操作重试保持原值
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The business error code, which is used to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

ConfigSnapshot.description_en: The snapshot of the model, content language, and runtime resources for this execution. This snapshot does not change when the task is updated
ConfigSnapshot.description_zh: 本次模型、内容语言和运行资源快照，不随任务更新改变

ContentLocale.description_en: The content language used for this execution

LlmModel.description_en: The specific model ID actually used and frozen for this execution. AUTO is not returned. This parameter can be empty for tasks that do not call models, such as pure synchronization tasks
LlmModel.description_zh: 本次实际使用并冻结的具体模型 ID，不返回 AUTO；纯同步等不调用模型的任务可为空

ProjectId.description_en: The DataWorks workspace ID used for this execution. This ID is frozen from the task definition when the instance is created
ProjectId.description_zh: 本次运行使用的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID，从创建实例时的任务定义冻结

RuntimeResource.description_en: The resource group and Builder CUs actually used for this execution
RuntimeResource.description_zh: 本次实际使用的资源组与 Builder CU

Cu.description_en: The Builder compute specifications. Valid values: 4 to 16. If this parameter is omitted during creation, the effective value is 4. The read operation returns the effective value
Cu.description_zh: Builder 计算规格，取值 4～16；创建省略时有效值为 4，读取返回有效值

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The DataWorks resource group ID used by the actual Builder nodes. The server validates that this resource group is available in the workspace corresponding to the top-level ProjectId of the task
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 真实 Builder 节点使用的 DataWorks 资源组 ID；服务端校验其在任务顶层 ProjectId 对应工作空间内可用

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created

CurrentStage.description_en: The current business stage. This parameter is returned when reliable records are available. For common build stages and semantic model import stages, refer to the domain model. This parameter does not replace the overall status
CurrentStage.description_zh: 当前业务阶段，有可靠记录时返回；普通构建阶段及语义模型导入阶段见领域模型，不替代整体 Status

Error.description_en: The error code and secure error message returned when the request fails
Error.description_zh: 失败时的错误码与安全错误信息

Code.description_en: The business error code, which is used to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Message.description_en: The secure error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

FinishedTime.description_en: The time when the execution finished. This parameter is optional

GeneratedModels.description_en: The confirmed ModelId and VersionNo for model imports only. For their structure, see GetKnowledgeBaseBuildTaskInstance
GeneratedModels.description_zh: 仅模型导入：已确认的 ModelId、VersionNo，结构见实例 Get 文档

ModelId.description_en: The model ID generated by the semantic layer. You can use this ID as a KnowledgeObjectId to read the corresponding semantic model
ModelId.description_zh: 语义层生成的模型 ID，可作为 KnowledgeObjectId 读取对应语义模型

VersionNo.description_en: The current version of the SEMANTIC_MODEL being read. Pass this value when updating content. The version can be edited in place
VersionNo.description_zh: SEMANTIC_MODEL 当前读取的版本；更新内容时传此值，版本可原地编辑

InputSnapshot.description_en: The non-sensitive input snapshot after selection and parsing for this execution. This snapshot does not change when the task is updated
InputSnapshot.description_zh: 本次选择及解析后的非敏感输入快照，不随任务更新改变

DocumentSourceCount.description_en: The number of external document sources selected for this execution. This parameter is not returned when it is not applicable
DocumentSourceCount.description_zh: 本次选择的外部文档来源数量；不适用时不返回

ResolvedEntities.description_en: The actual Data Map entities resolved from the project, database, or schema scope for this execution. This parameter is not returned when it is not applicable
ResolvedEntities.description_zh: 从项目、数据库或 Schema 范围解析出的本次实际数据地图实体；不适用时不返回

EntityId.description_en: The metadata entity ID returned by Data Map. The client passes this ID as is and does not concatenate database, schema, or table identifiers
EntityId.description_zh: 数据地图返回的元数据实体 ID；客户端原样传递，不自行拼接数据库、Schema 或表标识

EntityType.description_en: The entity level, such as DATABASE, SCHEMA, or TABLE. The server validates this parameter based on the Data Map identity. The presence of an enum value does not guarantee that all engines support it
EntityType.description_zh: 实体层级，如 DATABASE、SCHEMA、TABLE；服务端以数据地图身份校验，不因枚举存在就承诺所有引擎均支持

ResolvedEntityCount.description_en: The total number of resolved entities. An accurate count is returned even if the array is not returned due to its size
ResolvedEntityCount.description_zh: 已解析实体总数；数组因规模未返回时仍可返回准确数量

SelectedInput.description_en: The snapshot of the selection conditions in the task definition when the instance is created. This snapshot does not change when the task is updated
SelectedInput.description_zh: 创建实例时任务定义中的选择条件快照；不会随任务更新改变

Entities.description_en: The Data Map entities such as databases, schemas, and tables selected for data asset-scoped builds. The values are non-empty and deduplicated
Entities.description_zh: 数据资产范围构建选择的数据库、Schema、表等数据地图实体；非空、去重

EntityId.description_en: The metadata entity ID returned by Data Map. The client passes this ID as is and does not concatenate database, schema, or table identifiers
EntityId.description_zh: 数据地图返回的元数据实体 ID；客户端原样传递，不自行拼接数据库、Schema 或表标识

EntityType.description_en: The entity level, such as DATABASE, SCHEMA, or TABLE. The server validates this parameter based on the Data Map identity. The presence of an enum value does not guarantee that all engines support it
EntityType.description_zh: 实体层级，如 DATABASE、SCHEMA、TABLE；服务端以数据地图身份校验，不因枚举存在就承诺所有引擎均支持

KnowledgeObjectIds.description_en: The knowledge object IDs required when building from document objects in this knowledge base. The values must be non-empty and deduplicated. Each item is a KnowledgeObjectId with Type=DOCUMENT in this knowledge base. Do not mix these IDs with SourceIds for external connector synchronization scopes
KnowledgeObjectIds.description_zh: 从本库文档对象构建时必填、非空且去重；每项为本库 Type=DOCUMENT 的 KnowledgeObjectId；与外部连接器同步范围 SourceIds 不混用

items.description_en: The knowledge object IDs required when building from document objects in this knowledge base. The values must be non-empty and deduplicated. Each item is a KnowledgeObjectId with Type=DOCUMENT in this knowledge base. Do not mix these IDs with SourceIds for external connector synchronization scopes
items.description_zh: 从本库文档对象构建时必填、非空且去重；每项为本库 Type=DOCUMENT 的 KnowledgeObjectId；与外部连接器同步范围 SourceIds 不混用

ProjectIds.description_en: The DataWorks workspace IDs selected for workspace-scoped builds. The values are non-empty and deduplicated
ProjectIds.description_zh: 工作空间范围构建选择的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；非空、去重

items.description_en: The DataWorks workspace IDs selected for workspace-scoped builds. The values are non-empty and deduplicated
items.description_zh: 工作空间范围构建选择的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID；非空、去重

SourceIds.description_en: The IDs of registered sources in this knowledge base. The values are deduplicated. Whether this parameter is required and the allowed source types depend on the task input scenario. Refer to the following table
SourceIds.description_zh: 本库已登记来源的 ID，去重；是否必填及允许的来源类型由任务输入场景决定，见下表

items.description_en: The IDs of registered sources in this knowledge base. The values are deduplicated. Whether this parameter is required and the allowed source types depend on the task input scenario. Refer to the following table
items.description_zh: 本库已登记来源的 ID，去重；是否必填及允许的来源类型由任务输入场景决定，见下表

YamlUploadId.description_en: The YAML upload session ID in this knowledge base used for SEMANTIC_MODEL import tasks. This ID is bound when the task is created and cannot be mixed with other input scopes
YamlUploadId.description_zh: SEMANTIC_MODEL 导入任务使用的本库 YAML 上传会话 ID；创建任务时绑定，不能混用其他输入范围

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The knowledge base ID, which is used for scope validation and queries
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 所属知识库，便于范围校验和查询

StartedTime.description_en: The time when the execution started. This parameter is optional

Status.description_en: The overall status of this execution

TriggerType.description_en: The trigger type of this execution, such as manual, periodic, or supported events
TriggerType.description_zh: 本次由手动、周期或受支持的事件触发

Message.description_en: The secure error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
